therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: IL-1β-mediated pancreatic beta-cell dysfunction suppression and insulin secretion restoration
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Adults with type 2 diabetes mellitus on stable metformin therapy
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Mean change from baseline in plasma HbA1c and plasma glucose AUC 0-4 hours following OGTT

results.effect_size: HbA1c change at Day 84: -0.59% (canakinumab 1.5 mg/kg) vs +0.32% (pooled placebo); Glucose AUC change at Day 84: -2.5 mmol*h/L (10 mg/kg) vs +1.7 mmol*h/L (placebo 10 mg/kg)
results.target_engagement_evidence: Dose-dependent reductions in HbA1c and glucose AUC observed at higher doses (1.5 mg/kg and 10 mg/kg) suggesting IL-1β neutralization
biomarker_changes: HbA1c reduced by up to -0.59% at Day 84 with 1.5 mg/kg canakinumab vs +0.32% placebo
Glucose AUC reduced by -4.7 mmol*h/L at Day 28 with 10 mg/kg canakinumab vs -0.9 mmol*h/L placebo
C-peptide AUC increased with 1.5 mg/kg canakinumab (+654 pmol*h/L at Day 84) vs placebo (+240 pmol*h/L)
Fructosamine reduced by -16.6 µmol/L at Day 84 with 10 mg/kg canakinumab vs -12.1 µmol/L placebo
HOMA-β improved with 1.5 mg/kg canakinumab (43.3%) vs placebo (37.2%) at Day 84
Insulin/proinsulin ratio improved with 0.3 mg/kg canakinumab at Day 28 (+1.039) vs placebo (-0.031)
subgroup_findings: Cohort 2 (10 mg/kg): HbA1c -0.46% at Day 84 vs placebo -0.15%
Cohort 3 (1.5 mg/kg): HbA1c -0.59% at Day 84 vs pooled placebo +0.32%
Cohort 3 (0.1 mg/kg): HbA1c -0.04% at Day 84, minimal effect
Cohort 4 (0.03 mg/kg injection): HbA1c -0.15% at Day 84
Dose-dependent trend in HbA1c reduction with higher canakinumab doses
No deaths reported in any cohort
safety_signals: Overall adverse event profile appeared acceptable across all dose cohorts
SAEs were rare: 1 intestinal polyp in canakinumab 10 mg/kg arm; 1 acute MI and 1 MI in placebo 10 mg/kg arm
AEs above 5% frequency: 9 participants in canakinumab 10 mg/kg cohort vs 6 in placebo; 10 in canakinumab 0.03 mg/kg cohort vs 2 in placebo

dose_info.dose: 0.03 mg/kg (injection), 0.1 mg/kg, 0.3 mg/kg, 1.5 mg/kg, or 10 mg/kg (infusion)
dose_info.schedule: Single dose IV injection or IV infusion

context.duration: 168 days (approximately 24 weeks) for Cohorts 2-4; 56 days for Cohort 1

modulation_entries.hypothesis: Metformin's background glucose-lowering effect may confound or modulate the glycemic readout of canakinumab's anti-inflammatory beta-cell protection, but no differential interaction was demonstrated in this trial
modulation_entries.citation: Participants continued on their stable daily dose of metformin throughout the study
